title: Chapter 15 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of building, publishing, and platform‑specific settings in Unity!

questions.question: Which menu contains the Build Settings window?
questions.explanation: File → Build Settings.

questions.question: What is the first scene in the Build Settings list?
options: The scene with the highest index
questions.explanation: Index 0 is the initial scene.

questions.question: How do you change the target platform for your build?
questions.explanation: Select platform and click Switch Platform in Build Settings.

questions.question: Where can you set the application's icon?
questions.explanation: Player Settings has an Icon section.

questions.question: Which Player Settings field changes the displayed title of your game?
questions.explanation: Product Name appears in the title bar.

questions.question: The 'Development Build' checkbox enables profiling and debug logging.
questions.explanation: Yes, it includes debug symbols and allows Profiler connection.

questions.question: Which scripting backend is required for iOS?
questions.explanation: iOS only supports IL2CPP.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a Keystore for Android builds?
questions.explanation: The keystore signs APK/AAB for release.

questions.question: On Android, what is the unique identifier for your app called?
questions.explanation: It's usually `com.company.appname`.

questions.question: What does 'Minimum API Level' on Android control?
options: The lowest Android version the app can run on
questions.explanation: It sets the minimum supported Android OS version.

questions.question: What is required to build an iOS application?
options: A Mac with Xcode and an Apple Developer account
questions.explanation: iOS compilation requires Xcode on macOS.

questions.question: How does Unity WebGL execute C# code in the browser?
questions.explanation: IL2CPP compiles C# to WebAssembly.

questions.question: What should you use to test a WebGL build locally?
options: A local web server (e.g., Python http.server)
questions.explanation: WebGL requires a server; file:// protocol often fails.

questions.question: What does the WebGL Memory Size setting affect?
questions.explanation: It sets the WASM heap memory allocated.

questions.question: Where do you configure screen orientation for mobile?
questions.explanation: Allowed Orientations are in Player Settings.

questions.question: Which Unity feature simulates different mobile devices in the Editor?
questions.explanation: The Device Simulator package previews device screens.

questions.question: What is the 'Run In Background' option in Player Settings?
options: Allows the game to keep running when the window loses focus
Runs the game when the computer is idle
questions.explanation: It keeps the game loop active when not focused.

questions.question: For a release build, you should disable 'Development Build'.
questions.explanation: Development Build adds overhead and exposes debugging features.

questions.question: What does the 'Quality Settings' in Project Settings control?
questions.explanation: It manages visual fidelity presets.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a build target directly supported by Unity Personal?
questions.explanation: Console platforms require additional developer agreements and licenses.

questions.question: How do you install missing platform support modules?
questions.explanation: Use Unity Hub to add modules to an existing Editor install.

questions.question: The unique identifier for an Android app is called the _____.
questions.explanation: It's the package name, like com.company.game.

questions.question: What does 'IL2CPP' do?
options: Converts C# to C++ and then compiles to native code
questions.explanation: IL2CPP transpiles C# IL to C++ and then to native code.

questions.question: You can build for iOS on a Windows PC if you have a remote Mac.
questions.explanation: Unity's Build Settings can connect to a Mac for compilation, or you can generate the Xcode project and build on Mac later.
